# vcp_network (Data Source)

Fetches information about an existing isolated network by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a single isolated network by ID.
data "vcp_network" "example" {
  id = "your-network-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the network to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) The creation timestamp of the network in RFC3339 format.
- `description` (String) The description of the network.
- `gateway_ids` (List of String) List of gateway IDs currently attached to this network.
- `location_id` (String) The location ID where the network is deployed.
- `mask` (Number) The network mask (e.g., `24` for `/24`).
- `name` (String) The name of the network.
- `network_prefix` (String) The network prefix (e.g., `10.100.0.0`).
- `server_ids` (List of String) List of server IDs currently attached to this network.
- `tags` (Set of String) List of tags associated with the network.
